data.name: AndroidSdk_Not_Set
data.value: The path to the Android SDK has not been set. Either provide the '-p:AndroidSdkDirectory' MSbuild property with a valid path or set the 'ANDROID_HOME' or 'ANDROID_SDK_ROOT' environment variables and try again.
data.comment: The following are literal names and should not be translated: `Android SDK`, `ANDROID_HOME`, `ANDROID_SDK_ROOT` and `-p:AndroidSdkDirectory`

data.name: License_Not_Accepted
data.value: The Android SDK license agreements were not accepted. Read the Android SDK License Agreement at https://developer.android.com/studio/terms, then set `$(AcceptAndroidSDKLicenses)` to `true` to accept it.
data.comment: The following are literal names and should not be translated: `Android SDK`, `$(AcceptAndroidSDKLicenses)`, `true`, https://developer.android.com/studio/terms

data.name: Required_Not_Installed
data.value: The Android CLI did not install Android SDK package `{0}` into `{1}`. Make sure that the package name and version are correct.
data.comment: The following are literal names and should not be translated: `Android CLI`, `Android SDK` {0} - The Android SDK package that was not installed {1} - The path to the Android SDK

data.name: Task_Failed
data.value: Failed to install required Android SDK components.
data.comment: The following are literal names and should not be translated: `Android SDK`

data.name: Task_Cancelled
data.value: Attempt to install required Android SDK components timed out or was cancelled. Consider setting `$(AndroidDependencyInstallationTimeout)` to a value larger than `{0}` minutes.
data.comment: The following are literal names and should not be translated: `Android SDK`, `$(AndroidDependencyInstallationTimeout)` {0} - The timeout value for the task

data.name: Invalid_JavaSdkDirectory
data.value: Unable to install the Java SDK into `{0}`. Please set `$(JavaSdkDirectory)` to a valid non-administrator path.
data.comment: The following are literal names and should not be translated: `Java SDK`, `$(JavaSdkDirectory)`, `non-administrator` {0} - The value of $(JavaSdkDirectory) that was provided to the task

data.name: Invalid_JavaSdkDirectory_ExistingInstall
data.value: Detected an out of date Java SDK with version `{1}` at `{0}`, but we are unable to install the recommended Java SDK (version `{2}`) to this location. Please update your Java SDK to version `{2}`, or set `$(JavaSdkDirectory)` to a valid non-administrator path to install the recommended Java SDK version to a new location.
data.comment: The following are literal names and should not be translated: `Java SDK`, `$(JavaSdkDirectory)`, `non-administrator` {0} - The value of $(JavaSdkDirectory) that was provided to the task {1} - The major version of the the Java SDK that was already installed {2} - The major version of the the Java SDK to install

data.name: Invalid_JavaSdkVersion
data.value: Unable to find a Java SDK with version `{0}`. Please set `$(JavaSdkVersion)` to a valid version.
data.comment: The following are literal names and should not be translated: `Java SDK`, `$(JavaSdkVersion)` {0} - The value of $(JavaSdkVersion) that was provided to the task

data.name: XA5305
data.value: Could not verify the Microsoft OpenJDK archive signature for '{0}'. The archive will not be installed. {1}

data.name: XA5306
data.value: The Android CLI is not available for this operating system and architecture: `{0}` `{1}`.
data.comment: The following are literal names and should not be translated: `Android CLI` {0} - The operating system description {1} - The processor architecture

data.name: XA5307
data.value: The Android CLI downloaded from `{0}` has SHA-256 `{2}`, but SHA-256 `{1}` was expected. The Android CLI will not be used.
data.comment: The following are literal names and should not be translated: `Android CLI`, `SHA-256` {0} - The download URL {1} - The expected SHA-256 hash {2} - The SHA-256 hash of the downloaded file

data.name: XA5308
data.value: The Android CLI failed with exit code {0} while it installed Android SDK packages. Output: {1}
data.comment: The following are literal names and should not be translated: `Android CLI`, `Android SDK` {0} - The exit code {1} - The end of the Android CLI output
